scope: Fake ADB/receiver failure-injection cases run by independent harness agent before parent moved the early Android failure marker check. These supplement final real emulator runs; they do not prove physical behavior.

corrections.change: Both installed-APK validators accept the standard ~~ directory prefix while requiring one absolute /data/app APK path and a safe character set.
App-state scripts use non-PTY adb shell with a quoted sh -c argument and remote exit status; exec-out stdin is no longer used.

Package inventory must succeed and parse before absence is accepted. Existing test packages block the run. Installation uses no replacement flag; an explicit concurrent INSTALL_FAILED_ALREADY_EXISTS result is preserved and never uninstalled.

The inner Python supervisor atomically journals exact forward/reverse endpoints and the test APK hash before acquisition. Pending operations are reconciled after lost acknowledgments. Cleanup compares identities, preserves replacements/mismatches, and verifies absence. A recover operation lets the outer wrapper clean journaled artifacts after killing the inner process group; inner children do not start separate sessions.

Projection, optional force-stop, recovery, service inventory, app-state comparison, host result and Android cleanup marker each have independent error capture. One failure cannot skip remaining checks. Forced termination and all cleanup failures remain nonzero.
